description: Submits analysis options and queues a forensic analysis job. Returns upload_uid and job_uid. The call is idempotent. Requires X-Api-Key header.

expiry.description: How long the analysis result remains accessible after the job completes. Default: 1d. Free-tier keys are silently clamped to upload.free_max_expiry (default 1d); Pro accounts get the requested value.

face_detection.description: Enable YuNet face detection. Default: true.

face_sensitivity.description: standard: confidence threshold 0.5 (fewer false positives). thorough: threshold 0.2 (catches more faces). Default: standard.

forensic_depth.description: standard: core forensic checks. deep: extended checks (reserved, currently identical to standard). Default: standard.

text_detection.description: Enable OCR / text region detection. Default: true.

name: snapwonders_analyse_job_start
